definitions.explanation: The western half of Japan — typically Kinki, Chūgoku, Shikoku, and Kyūshū. The exact dividing line varies by context (weather, sports, business).

examples.japanese: {西日本|にしにほん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}った→降る：00839_furu⟧。
examples.english: Heavy rain fell in western Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{西日本|にしにほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄味|うすあじ}→薄味：15432_usuaji⟧だ。
examples.english: Udon broth is lighter in western Japan.

examples.japanese: {西日本|にしにほん}⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{満開|まんかい}→満開：13319_mankai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えている→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: Cherry blossoms are reaching full bloom across western Japan.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{西|にし}→西：00659_nishi⟧ (west) + ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧. Roughly contrasts with {東日本|ひがしにほん} (eastern Japan); the exact dividing point varies — weather forecasts, electric utilities (50 Hz vs 60 Hz), and JR companies all draw the line slightly differently.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {西日本|にしにほん}⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧: places across western Japan
- {西日本|にしにほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: centered on western Japan (news phrasing)
- {西日本|にしにほん}⟦{豪雨|ごうう}→豪雨：05860_gouu⟧: the 2018 'Western Japan Heavy Rain' disaster
- {西日本|にしにほん}⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧: from western Japan

CULTURAL NOTE:
Western and eastern Japan differ in many everyday details: food seasoning (lighter broth in the west), escalator etiquette (stand on the right in Osaka, on the left in Tokyo), and dialect. {西日本|にしにほん} is therefore a useful cultural shorthand, not just a geographic label.

RELATED WORDS:
- {東日本|ひがしにほん}: eastern Japan
- ⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧: Kansai region — narrower; centered on Osaka, Kyoto, Kobe
- ⟦{九州|きゅうしゅう}→九州：15647_kyuushuu⟧: Kyushu — the southwestern main island, part of {西日本|にしにほん}
